# Yanis Sebastian Zürcher

> Yanis Sebastian Zürcher is a software developer based in Zürich, Switzerland, specializing in full-stack development, web applications, and modern technologies.

Currently studying software engineering at WISS, working a software engineering internship at Nadlo (React, Next.js, NestJS, Supabase), and taking on freelance/contract web development (React, Next.js, Spring Boot) on the side. Has a background in identity & access management and cybersecurity from a prior IAM internship. Personal projects mostly run on React/Next.js/TypeScript on the frontend with Supabase/PostgreSQL for data, Spring Boot or Rust where a project calls for it, and a long-running interest in offensive security (OSINT, Kali Linux, Burp Suite). Content is available in English, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese via a language switcher; the URLs below serve the English version.

## Projects

Ordered by current relevance. Each has its own deep-dive page.

- [Kinoa](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/kinoa): Free streaming site for films and series, no subscription — Next.js App Router, Supabase, PostgreSQL.
- [Sola](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/sola): This portfolio site — React (Vite), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Three.js.
- [fleetmap](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/fleetmap): Live map of a delivery fleet for an office screen, showing each van's stops, ETA and delay, with any past day replayable from its recorded track. Client work, not publicly accessible — Next.js, Supabase, MapLibre, OSRM.
- [Ura](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/ura): Snowmobile navigation app for Finnish Lapland on iOS and Android. It works without signal and shows whether you are on a route or how far the nearest one is. Client work — React, Capacitor, MapLibre.
- [perspectas.ch](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/perspectas): Website of perspectas gmbh, a consulting and recruiting firm near Zürich, whose two partners edit every text and image themselves in a CMS. Client work — Next.js, Sanity, Tailwind CSS.
- [Montu](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/montu): Journal of Swiss mountain tours in German, built for the client who writes and photographs them. A GPX upload draws each route on a terrain map with its elevation profile — Next.js, Sanity, Mapbox.
- [magi](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/magi): Fast, asynchronous TCP/UDP port scanner written in Rust with tokio.
- [Luma](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/luma): Multi-model, bring-your-own-key AI chat platform — Next.js 16, Vercel AI SDK, Supabase.
- [AppliCare](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/applicare): Job application tracking system — React (Vite), Spring Boot, MongoDB.
- [Self](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/self): Customizable Windows system-info display tool inspired by Neofetch, built with Python.
- [QR](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/qr): QR code generator that runs in the browser, with styled dots, corners, gradients and logos, export to PNG, SVG, JPEG or WebP, and a built-in scan test that reads the finished code back — Next.js, qr-code-styling, qr-scanner.
- [Website Code Extractor](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/code-extractor): Chrome and Edge extension for extracting and downloading a website's source code.
- [Thoughts](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/thoughts): Minimal personal site for reflections and notes, with a custom guestbook.
- [Taco](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/taco): Website about my brother's dog, built as a reusable Next.js template with English, Spanish and Japanese pages and a blog.
- [Vault](https://sola.ysz.life/projects/vault): Local sandbox for learning OpenID Connect, where Keycloak issues the tokens, a FastAPI service verifies them and the identity setup is declared in Terraform — Keycloak, FastAPI, Terraform, Next.js.
